topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session and frames the scope of the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Response and Leukocyte Recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells mobilize leukocytes, coordinate tissue trafficking, and drive local and systemic inflammatory processes.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Repair, and Chronic Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how the immune system shuts down active inflammation, restores injured tissue, and adapts to persistent challenges.
